entities.name: Ribosomal protein uL15
observations: The 144-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to curated UniProt protein Q2S931 from Hahella chejuensis.
uL15 binds 23S rRNA and is part of the bacterial 50S large ribosomal subunit.
Pfam matches: Ribosomal_uL15_N at residues 23–59 and Ribosomal_L27A at residues 79–143.
The sequence is highly basic (predicted pI 10.50; charge at pH 7 approximately +11.6), supporting interaction with negatively charged rRNA.
The protein is associated with cytosolic large-ribosomal-subunit structure, rRNA binding, and translation.
No evidence supports ATPase activity; the apparent GKT sequence occurs in a ribosomal-protein context and is not sufficient to establish a P-loop NTPase.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: uL15 contributes to protein synthesis as a structural and rRNA-binding component of the 50S ribosomal subunit.

entities.name: Cytosolic 50S ribosomal subunit
observations: The protein is annotated to the cytosolic large ribosomal subunit, GO:0022625.
